# dsh-github-intelligence

> Developer intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: 201 read-only tools across GitHub, 16 external ecosystems, and the dsh registry. Includes an authenticated maintainer inbox and evidence-based repository health audits.

## Key facts

- Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add <tarball>` (see GitHub Releases) or `github:zoahdev/dsh-github-intelligence`
- Flagship tools: `github_repo_report`, `github_weekly_digest`, `github_notifications`, `github_repo_health`, `github_compare`, `github_trending`, `arxiv_search`, and `github_help`
- Config: `githubToken`, `timeoutMs`, `defaultLimit`, `bodyPreviewChars`, `cacheTtlMs`, `userAgent`
- Verification: 52 unit tests; 201 tools visible in a real DSH agent registry; multi-ecosystem real-network smoke; CI installs the bundle into a fresh dsh profile and boots `dsh web`

## Key files

- src/catalog.ts — declarative tool catalog (specs, parsers, schemas, renderers)
- src/github.ts — GitHub REST client with TTL cache
- src/ecosystems.ts — generic multi-ecosystem JSON client
- src/index.ts — plugin entry, flagship tools, registration
- README.md — full EN/ZH documentation
